profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at EQT Inc
profile.summary: A software developer who takes on tough challenges. Currently, I'm developing solutions utilize AWS, NodeJS, VueJS, Python, Kubernetes and Docker containers.  Previous experiences including Spark, MapReduce, HBase, Oozie, Sqoop, Java, Scala, Python, PostgreSQL to ETL data and presents analytic results via a web interface.  Besides developing solutions, I also moonlighting as a DevOps engineer.  I manage my team's AWS infrastructure and CI/CD deployment pipeline.
